binaries.name: capa
binaries.why: Match a binary against capability rules over features extracted from the file (which can include imports, strings and instructions) and report named capabilities with the features and addresses they matched. A match is a rule-supported hypothesis about what the code can do, not observed behaviour; the rule set and version used are part of the result.

install.apt: pinned download 9.4.0 (install.download): upstream standalone release, whose embedded rules make offline analysis work

binaries.name: floss
binaries.why: Recover strings a sample builds or decodes at runtime by analysis and emulation of its code, without running the sample on a host. Recovery is incomplete and depends on the format, architecture and version; a recovered string is derived, not read at a file offset.

binaries.name: olevba
binaries.why: Extract VBA macro source from an Office document and name its auto-execution entry points. An entry-point name shows what a macro declares, not that anything ran.

binaries.name: r2
binaries.why: Disassembly, cross-references and function discovery from the command line, scriptable.

install.apt: pinned download 6.2.2 (install.download): upstream's .deb per architecture; radare2 is not in Debian 12, only in unstable

binaries.name: yara
binaries.why: Match a sample against a rule set and report each match, with the offsets of its string matches where the rule has strings (a condition-only match has none). The pack ships no rules.

binaries.name: strings
binaries.why: A first pass over a binary before a parser is chosen. Always search UTF-16LE as well, which strings -el does.

binaries.name: readelf
binaries.why: Print an ELF file's headers, dynamic section, notes (including the GNU build ID) and symbol tables with GNU binutils, to cross-check pe_info's reading and to read what it does not.

binaries.name: ssdeep
binaries.why: Compute context-triggered piecewise hashes so related binaries can be clustered even when their cryptographic hashes differ.

binaries.name: tlsh
binaries.why: Compute and compare Trend Micro Locality Sensitive Hashes for samples with sufficient size and byte diversity.

binaries.name: upx
binaries.why: Test and decompress UPX-compressed executables on a copy, without executing them, preserving the original and recording both hashes. A failure does not show that a file is not packed.

install.apt: pinned download 5.2.1 (install.download): upstream static release per architecture

binaries.name: gcc
binaries.why: Compile a small C program the seat itself writes, in the job's own directory: a scanner over a memory image too large for Python to hold, a decoder for a format no library reads. The source and the build line stay in the record like any other tool. Never a program or a source tree the evidence holds: nothing from the evidence is executed.
binaries.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later with the GCC Runtime Library Exception

binaries.name: make
binaries.why: Build a tool distributed as source, from a tree the operator or a pack supplied; never a source tree the evidence holds.
